Harlow is a beautiful 2yr old, 40lb, Standard Poodle. She was purchased from a breeder as a puppy. The people who bought her returned her to the breeder in the most deplorable condition imaginable. Her right front leg had two large growths and the paw had a huge black mass that appeared necrotic–the leg was also very inflamed. She was skin and bones and had an eye that appeared infected. Without hesitation, we agreed to take Harlow. Our doctors and Oncologist agreed that immediate surgery was needed. She is now recovering in a foster home while we await her test results.

As you can imagine the medical bills are substantial. Anything you can do will help so much.

Harlow is a beautiful 2yr old, 40lb, Standard Poodle. She was purchased from a breeder as a puppy. The people who bought her returned her to the breeder in the most deplorable condition imaginable. Her right front leg had two large growths and the paw had a huge black mass that appeared necrotic--the leg was also very inflamed. She was skin and bones and had an eye that appeared infected. Without hesitation, we agreed to take Harlow. Our doctors and Oncologist agreed that the immediate amputation of her right leg was needed. She is now recovering in a foster home while we await her test results.

As you can imagine the medical bills are substantial. Anything you can do will help so much.
